components.name: Primary Action Button (Bill & Pay)
components.description: High-conversion forward action button triggering thermal printing and UPI payment.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ea580c, #f97316); color: #ffffff; padding: 14px 24px; border-radius: 16px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; border: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(234, 88, 12, 0.3); transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), filter 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(234, 88, 12, 0.4); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Secondary Button (Punch KOT)
components.description: Neutral operational button dispatching order tickets directly to kitchen display.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #f3eee9; color: #291a13; padding: 14px 20px; border-radius: 16px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid #e8dfd8; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #e8dfd8; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Quantity Stepper Pill
components.description: High-speed increment/decrement control for dish card and order line items.
components.css: .ds-stepper { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; background: #ea580c; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 3px 6px; width: 92px; height: 36px; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(234, 88, 12, 0.25); } .ds-stepper-btn { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: #ffffff; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s; } .ds-stepper-btn:active { transform: scale(0.85); } .ds-stepper-count { font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #ffffff; min-width: 18px; text-align: center; }

components.name: Floating Cart FAB
components.description: Elevated persistent floating cart trigger with active count badge.
components.html: 3
components.css: .ds-fab-wrap { position: relative; display: inline-block; } .ds-fab { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 9999px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ea580c, #f97316); color: #ffffff; border: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(234, 88, 12, 0.4); transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-fab:hover { transform: scale(1.05); box-shadow: 0 16px 36px rgba(234, 88, 12, 0.5); } .ds-fab:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-fab-badge { position: absolute; top: -4px; right: -4px; background: #221008; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 9999px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 2px solid #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.2); }

components.name: Search Input Field
components.description: Tactile search input with warm orange glow on focus.
components.css: .ds-search-wrap { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e8dfd8; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 20px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(50, 36, 27, 0.04); transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-search-wrap:focus-within { border-color: #ea580c; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3.5px rgba(234, 88, 12, 0.18), 0 6px 20px -4px rgba(234, 88, 12, 0.15); } .ds-search-input { border: none; outline: none; background: transparent; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #291a13; width: 100%; } .ds-search-input::placeholder { color: #857065; }

narrative.overview:
ServeJoy marries the warm, sensory atmosphere of a boutique artisanal café with the uncompromising velocity of a high-volume quick-service restaurant terminal. Built from the counter outward, every screen prioritizes split-second scanability, ergonomic fingertip tapping, and reassuring visual feedback. The interface rests on a soothing warm cream canvas, anchored by deep roasted-espresso top navigation bars and ignited by vivid saffron-orange call-to-actions that direct the cashier's attention instantly during rush-hour order rushes.

We explicitly reject the sterile, cold corporate tech-blue tables, dense gray spreadsheets, and clinical utilitarian aesthetics of legacy desktop POS software. Likewise, we steer clear of distracting neon cyberpunk gradients and harsh pitch-black drop shadows that erode warmth. Instead, ServeJoy feels welcoming, tactile, and delicious: rich dish photography takes center stage, pill buttons invite immediate physical interaction, and ambient coffee-tinted drop shadows ground cards naturally in space.
keyCharacteristics: Counter Velocity: 1-click workflows with zero latency; high-frequency modifiers (quantity steppers, table pills, bill punch) are tuned for rapid one-handed touch.
Warm Culinary Palette: Roasted espresso brown (#221008) provides authority and contrast; spiced saffron (#ea580c) guides user action; warm cream (#faf7f2) prevents eye fatigue.
Tactile Soft Geometry: Generous pill borders (9999px) and smooth card curvatures (24px) create a friendly, approachable touch environment.
Organic Depth: Gentle warm shadows infused with roasted coffee undertones replace synthetic gray drop shadows.

rules.name: The Saffron Action Rule
rules.body: Vivid Spiced Saffron (#ea580c) is reserved exclusively for forward purchasing actions, affirmative selections, and active states (Cart FAB, Add to Order, Bill & Pay, Active Tab/Table). It must never be diluted on decorative borders, passive icons, or neutral badges.

rules.name: The Espresso Anchor Rule
rules.body: High-density headers, terminal badges, and primary app shells use Roasted Espresso (#221008) to anchor the eye and establish operational authority.

rules.name: The Monetary Monospace Rule
rules.body: All currency totals (₹), bill numbers, KOT ticket identifiers, and kitchen order timers must render in tabular JetBrains Mono to ensure effortless vertical alignment across receipts and ledger lines.

rules.name: The Ambient Shadow Rule
rules.body: Cards and containers never use harsh black drop shadows. All shadows are tinted with roasted coffee undertones (rgba(50, 36, 27, ...)) to preserve warm organic atmosphere.

dos: Do maintain a minimum 44x44px touch hitbox on all quantity modifiers, stepper buttons, and bill triggers.
Do render all currency amounts in Indian Rupees (₹) accompanied by tabular JetBrains Mono font formatting.
Do keep bottom clearance (pb-28 to pb-36) across all scroll views so persistent navigation chrome never occludes interactive content.
Do tint drop shadows with warm roasted espresso undertones (rgba(50, 36, 27, ...)) instead of raw black or gray.
Do preserve the 7-screen mobile bottom navigation bar across all screen viewports.
donts: Don't use cold corporate blue, harsh gray spreadsheets, or clinical enterprise tables.
Don't apply Spiced Saffron (#ea580c) to non-interactive decorative elements or secondary background containers.
Don't hide or obscure the floating cart button behind bottom navigation chrome on any screen size.
Don't allow long page margins or empty blank side gutters on widescreen displays; scale the grid smoothly up to 6 columns.
Don't block counter operations with network loaders; maintain zero-latency local-first UI updates.
